rule: After production, lead-loss, incorrect-data and broken-user-journey emergencies, finish the approved Search3 design across the site, publish a coherent preview, verify the user journey and prepare a reversible migration. Production draft #1334 must not merge or deploy until explicit owner visual approval of the concrete release. Preview publishing and draft preparation are authorized. Preserve AnyTour Design System 2.0, logo, Tourvisor/API contract, price arithmetic, lead transport/field mapping, Metrika/goals and repository isolation. Keep technical refactor and mass SEO expansion deferred. Do not invent benefits, operating hours or legal/payment terms.

scoped_refactor_authorization.scope: Search3 presentation source ownership and reproducible build; preserve served behavior, cascade order and protected contracts

required: exact artifact build and focused presentation/source checks
verification_policy.restore: ready_for_review event on each affected workflow; production approval still required
verification_policy.live: Do not publish or repeat the live journey for each behavior-preserving technical pass. Publish at an accumulated checkpoint, for a relevant behavior/layout change, or on owner request. When publishing, inspect only the changed area; a complete search/flight/lead journey is required only if the affected behavior needs it.

working_code_draft: one exact artifact build (including PHP/path/presentation/isolation checks)
ci_execution.artifact_reuse: Keep the successful working-PR source artifact after release fast-forward and documentation checkpoints; do not rebuild or redeploy docs.
ci_execution.restoration: Non-draft PRs restore all applicable workflows on ready_for_review.

batch_execution.working_draft: Keep multiple useful reductions in one release-based draft; use separate logical commits where practical, then one final push/CI cycle per completed batch.
batch_execution.local_checks: Build generated assets once after the source batch and measure the eight served files. Run the narrow existing equivalence or affected-behavior check. Do not repeat the artifact workflow's full check set locally.
batch_execution.ci: Retain the two existing mandatory working-source jobs, successful on the final source SHA. Do not disable security, owner validators, protected paths or preview isolation. Reuse the successful artifact.
batch_execution.publication: A checked technical batch may remain unpublished in release; no deploy-control PR, artifact download or browser session is required merely because another source PR completed. Reuse the final checked source artifact at the next justified publication.
batch_execution.budget_rule: The manual-check timebox is not acceptance. If relevant evidence cannot be completed, record it as deferred and keep the uncertain change out of the verified batch; continue independent safe reductions.
batch_execution.reduction_priority: Prefer measured elimination of large duplicate CSS/JS source blocks. Include small reductions opportunistically; do not spend a separate PR/deploy/browser cycle on a micro-saving.
batch_execution.reporting: Report net generated CSS/JS bytes and whether the checked batch is published. Do not count moved code or line-count reduction as payload savings.
batch_execution.production: Production approval, protected contracts, ready_for_review restoration and actual deployment guards remain unchanged. Owner explicitly resumed hourly Search3 development.

whole_layer_retirement.scope: Large reversible Search3 presentation-layer retirement with compact preservation of needed rules/handlers and repair of concrete isolated-preview breakage.
